name: Spruce Peak (Stowe, Vermont, early October)
note: Course theme palette (32 colours, same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). The Mountain Course at Spruce Peak, Stowe VT, drawn in the first week of October, peak foliage on the Green Mountains: cool-season turf still a bright, slightly blue green (G4-G9); rough a deeper green (G2-G4); the meadows and ski trails around the course (OB grass, L0-L2) gone olive-gold; leaf litter under the hardwoods (B0-B2, russet); white sand with a grey cast (S0-S2, crushed granite); a dark slate-blue mountain pond (W0-W2); grey schist ledge and gravel paths (K). Trees in assets-src/trees_spruce_peak.py: red spruce and balsam fir as narrow dark spires, sugar maple in red-orange, yellow and paper birch in gold, beech and late maples still green with a turning patch. The colours by variant are a drawing choice, not a surveyed species (the lidar gives only crown shape). Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
